constraints: The window is not displayed automatically: a command that loads a form (e.g. ADD RECORD) must still be called to actually show the form in the window.
'Form has full screen mode Mac' and 'Form has no menu bar' are modifier constants that must be added to one of the other type constants, not used alone.
hPos/vPos are only used the first time the window is opened when the '*' parameter is passed (position/size are then remembered across closes/reopens).
Position parameters are expressed relative to the top-left of the application window's content area (Windows MDI mode) or the main screen (macOS and Windows SDI mode).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Opens a new window sized/positioned per the form formName's resizing properties (formName may be a form name, a POSIX path to a .json form description file, or a form-description object), returning the window reference number.
